name: @gcu/compo
description: A figure / page composer: a page (A5–A2, Letter, custom mm; portrait or landscape) with frames placed freely on it — renders, plots, legends, scale bars, north arrows, captions with fields — drawn by one path onto a canvas, a PNG or a vector PDF (@gcu/pdf). A host-agnostic DOM editor (move, resize, snap, align, distribute, undo). Plain-JSON documents.
author: Arthur Endlein Correia
